method: Interactive browser inspection of the public Cloud Run frontend, without signing in

observations.detail: The public app rendered its input form and six live trending event buttons.

observations.message: Use a polymarket.com event or market link, or paste its event slug.

observations.detail: Selecting Fed Decision in December? populated the input. Score it displayed five live market cards with crowd/model probabilities and percentage-point differences.
All five cards rendered daily price charts and the current model estimate. Two markets displayed the near-certain/out-of-training-range warning.
Expanded panel displayed test/training dates and stated that the confidence interval includes zero.

Inspected the default narrow browser layout and a 1280 x 900 desktop viewport. Narrow cards stack the two probabilities; desktop cards display them side by side. Charts render in both layouts. Temporary viewport override was reset.

scope: Observed live behavior at the recorded time. This is a manual browser report; automated test and container results are recorded separately in CI. No trades were placed.
